rounds.text: Shine Fashions (India) Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at an inexpensive P/E of 7.23x [E1] while delivering extraordinary fundamental growth, including a 5-year compounded sales growth of 71% [E8] and a 5-year compounded profit growth of 111% [E11]. The underlying business model is exceptionally profitable and efficient, evidenced by an outstanding 35.0% ROE [E7] and a 31.1% ROCE [E6], metrics that vastly outperform the broader sector median ROCE of 7.6% [E65]. This exceptional operational quality is further reinforced by a long-term upward trend in operating margins over the last six years [E22] alongside recent insider alignment through an increase in promoter holding over the last quarter [E48]. Independent valuation modeling utilizing discounted cash flows suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 47 per share, offering a substantial margin of safety of 44.9% [E34] against the current market price of Rs 25.8 [E2]. Furthermore, the stock's current price reflects an overly pessimistic outlook, implying an earnings growth rate of just 9.8% compared to the 18.0% baseline assumption [E35]. Conceded: operating cash flows turned negative at Rs -24.40 Cr in Mar 2026 alongside high debtors of 173 days [E25, E50].
